Name: Clean George
Author: zvarri
Description:
Just because George is old and bitter doesn't mean he can't look presentable.  This is just a (really) simple mod that gets rid of that disgusting stain (like, what even IS that?  Neon green puke?) on his shirt and fixes the dents and stains on his wheelchair.

Extract the file however you like to extract things and install to Stardew Valley>Content>Portraits.

Downloads.Description: This mod cleans the junk off George's shirt and fixes the notches in his wheelchair.
